thread.title: Is Trump Beating Warren Buffett in Predicting US Market Moves?

title: Is Trump Beating Warren Buffett in Predicting US Market Moves?
text: Is Trump Beating Warren Buffett in Predicting US Market Moves? More Today US markets seem to be witnessing a recovery that investors have been waiting a long time for. A sharp market sell-off that started in October paused in November but again intensified in December. Last week, key US indexes (VTI) the S&P 500 Index (SPY), the NASDAQ Composite Index (QQQ), and the Dow Jones Industrial Average (DIA) tanked by 7.1%, 8.4%, and 6.9%, respectively. Amazon (AMZN), Ford (F), Alphabet (GOOG), Facebook (FB), Microsoft (MSFT), Nucor (NUE), and Apple (AAPL) tanked 13.5%, 5.5%, 5.7%, 13.3%, 7.4%, 11.3%, and 8.9% last week, respectively.
